rules.quote: a plan, decision log or working note goes to `.claude/plans` or `.claude/notes`, never to `docs/`
rules.rule: Put plans, decision logs, and working notes in `.claude/plans` or `.claude/notes`, never in `docs/`.

rules.quote:
When a
plan is implemented, its user-visible result is documented in `docs/` (module note, API, uk onboarding).
rules.rule: When a plan is implemented, document its user-visible result in `docs/` (module note, API, or uk onboarding).

rules.quote:
Docs-only and
`.claude/**` pushes do not trigger `auto-release.yml`.
rules.rule: Do not expect docs-only pushes or pushes limited to `.claude/**` to trigger `auto-release.yml`.
Never add any AI-usage notes anywhere (in commits, PRs, code, comments, or documents).
Never add a `Co-Authored-By: Claude` trailer to commit messages.
Never include session links in commits, PRs, code, or documents.
Never include a "Generated with Claude Code" note in commits, PRs, code, or documents.

rules.quote: no "author: Claude" in docs or plans
rules.rule: Never write "author: Claude" in docs or plans.

rules.quote: Commit as the owner: `git -c user.name=Alsesd -c user.email=mr.alsesd@gmail.com commit`
rules.rule: Commit as the owner by running git commit with `-c user.name=Alsesd -c user.email=mr.alsesd@gmail.com`.

rules.quote: Do NOT rewrite existing history to remove old notes
rules.rule: Do not rewrite existing git history to remove old AI-attribution notes.

rules.quote: this overrides any harness attribution reminder
rules.rule: When writing commit messages, PR bodies, comments, and documents, the no-AI-attribution rule overrides any harness attribution reminder.

rules.quote: When interference between slices is noticed, fix it in the same task, do not just report it.
rules.rule: When interference between slices is noticed, fix it in the same task instead of just reporting it.

rules.quote: Before finishing any task that touches a module or the shell, run `go test ./internal/registry/`
rules.rule: Before finishing any task that touches a module or the shell, run `go test ./internal/registry/`.
Before finishing any task that touches a module or the shell, run `npx vitest run src/boundaries.test.ts` for frontend rules.

rules.quote: New shell->module needs go through a `core.Module` hook
rules.rule: Route any new shell-to-module need through a `core.Module` hook, never by importing the module from `platform`, `web`, or `store`.

rules.quote: A module needing a platform service gets it as an interface in `core`
rules.rule: When a module needs a platform service, provide it as an interface in `core`.

rules.quote: Shared pure helpers used by several slices live in `core`
rules.rule: Place shared pure helpers used by several slices in `core`.

rules.quote: Record every leak found and its fix in `project-slice-boundaries.md`.
rules.rule: Record every slice-boundary leak found and its fix in `project-slice-boundaries.md`.

rules.quote: write font sizes in rem (`text-[0.9375rem]`), never `text-[Npx]`
rules.rule: When writing font sizes in the UI, use rem units (e.g. `text-[0.9375rem]`), never px units (e.g. `text-[Npx]`).
Keep touch-target minimum heights at `min-h-[44px]`.
Avoid using CSS `zoom` in the UI.
Register every route via a.authed(codes, h) or a.member(codes, h).

rules.quote: org-scope permissions only touch the caller's org.
rules.rule: Make org-scoped permission changes affect only the caller's own organization.
Perform all data mutations inside a.write(ctx, func(tx)).
Inside a.write, use only the transaction passed to the callback, not other database handles.

rules.quote: Notifications and audit rows are written in the SAME tx as the event.
rules.rule: Write notification and audit rows in the same transaction as the event they record.
Store and compute money as integer cents.
Represent periods in the format YYYY-MM.
Never touch data/, backups/, reports.db, secret.key, or .env.
Define tables added after the base schema in goOwned in store/schema.go and register them in GoOwnedTables.
Add columns added after the base schema via goOwnedColumns as idempotent ALTER statements.

rules.quote: tested on an older DB via `baseOnly` in `store_test.go`
rules.rule: Test schema changes against an older database using baseOnly in store_test.go.

rules.quote: Frozen fixtures in `testdata/` change only on purpose, with the reason in the commit.
rules.rule: Change frozen fixtures in testdata/ only deliberately, and state the reason in the commit message.
Run go vet and go test ./cmd/... ./internal/... as the verification gate.
Never run go test or go vet with the ./... pattern.
Run frontend lint, typecheck, test, and build as part of verification.
For UI work, also run scripts/build_go.sh, the go run ./cmd/smoke binary smoke test with -tunnel, and scripts/e2e_test.py.
Run the verify skill before committing a finished feature.

rules.quote: commit + push each finished feature on branch `claude/go-migration-umm1ck`
rules.rule: Commit and push each finished feature on branch claude/go-migration-umm1ck.

rules.quote: update `docs/API.md`, `schema.d.ts` (hand-maintained), module docs with every API change.
rules.rule: With every API change, update docs/API.md, the hand-maintained schema.d.ts, and the module docs.

rules.quote: from now on treat existing databases as production data again
rules.rule: Treat existing databases as production data, not disposable test data.

rules.quote: LoginPage tries the modal once (device agreed, not right after sign-out)
rules.rule: When the login page starts biometric sign-in, try the modal passkey prompt once, and only if the device has opted in and the user did not just sign out.

rules.quote:
then WebAuthn conditional
mediation (`autocomplete="username webauthn"`, `passkeyApi.login({conditional, signal})`)
rules.rule: If the modal attempt is not used, start passkey sign-in via WebAuthn conditional mediation by setting the input's autocomplete to "username webauthn" and calling passkeyApi.login({conditional, signal}).

rules.quote:
test the sign-out case with isConditionalMediationAvailable
stubbed to false
rules.rule: When testing the sign-out case with a headless virtual authenticator, stub isConditionalMediationAvailable to return false, because the virtual authenticator completes conditional requests by itself.

rules.quote: `.dialog-panel` in index.css centres by inset+margin (never transform)
rules.rule: Center dialog panels using inset and margin, never CSS transform.
Implement the bell's popover using the ui/Popover component.
Write UI strings in Ukrainian and place them in i18n.ts.
Use the `.figure` class for figures.
Do not use native month or file input controls.
Make touch targets 44px.
Apply Tailwind colours through CSS-variable tokens.

rules.quote: `schema.d.ts` edited by hand with every API change
rules.rule: Edit schema.d.ts by hand with every API change.
Fetch data via react-query.

rules.quote: sections poll (`refetchInterval`) instead of full reloads
rules.rule: Have sections poll with refetchInterval instead of performing full reloads.
Never block transport orders placed late, including after the old 15:00 cutoff.
Never set update.Tag on development builds, because doing so switches self-update on.

rules.quote: Business metrics belong on the separate management dashboard, not here.
rules.rule: Put business metrics on the management dashboard, not on the technical health page.
Ask the user before adding a reminder for orders due today or for unclosed orders.
Never display 4xx responses in red; treat them as refusals.
Base backup health on the backup job's own last_run_at and last_error, not on the age of the newest backup file.

rules.quote: device notifications go through the service worker
rules.rule: Deliver device notifications through the service worker, not by calling new Notification().
When saving a report, replace the item quantities; never add to them.

rules.quote: only DAYS are lockable, the month is review-only
rules.rule: Allow locking only individual report days; the monthly report is review-only and must not be lockable.
Keep the stored transport status codes unchanged.
Compute today() in reports and transport using core.Services.Zone (the business zone), not time.Local.
The core package must not import any internal package.
The store package must not import any internal package.
The platform package may import only core and store.
The system package may import only store.
The reports package may import only core.
The transport package may import only core.

rules.quote: web -> core, platform, registry, store, system, update (NO module)
rules.rule: The web package may import core, platform, registry, store, system, and update, but must not import any module package.

rules.quote: registry and `cmd/server` are the only wiring points that list modules.
rules.rule: Only the registry package and cmd/server may list modules; no other package should list modules.
Frontend platform/ and ui/ code must never import from modules/ or app/.

rules.quote: a module imports neither another module nor `app/`
rules.rule: Frontend module code must not import another module or anything from app/.
Place a module's HTTP handlers in files named internal/<module>/http*.go.

rules.quote: Need more from the shell for a module -> add a field to `core.Services`, never import.
rules.rule: When a module needs more from the shell, add a field to core.Services instead of importing the shell from the module.
Register each module route behind a.authed or a.member in the shell.

dropped.quote:
must be
separated from each other and interact with the rest of the program **only through `core`** (Go) or `platform/` + `ui/`
frontend
dropped.rule: Keep feature slices (modules) separated from each other and have them interact with the rest of the program only through `core` (Go) or `platform/` + `ui/` (frontend).
